items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Even Fats Domino [sings “I’m Walking.] You see? So it’s all based within that, that whole New Orleans concept is based within that.

ctx.x: Can you put it into words?

Well just a two feel, with a really kind of Gospel type of beat. This is kind of like the triangle I try to play within. I don’t know if you could hear the whole thing but I try to go [percussive claps]. So the whole New Orleans concept is within that. Because if you think like [sings “Saints”]. Even Fats Domino [sings “I’m Walking.] You see? So it’s all based within that, that whole New Orleans concept is based within that. And so we try to keep that element quite naturally, even though we don’t play that all…
Too much brain and not enough—
